notes: Cloudflare's API MCP server covers the whole Cloudflare API through search and execute tools, signing in with OAuth (or a self-created API token); 16 product-specific MCP servers also exist. Discovery 2026-10-08: DCR yes, CIMD yes, S256.

name: App Store Connect
alternative: none
notes: No Apple MCP; the App Store Connect API uses keys created in App Store Connect that sign short-lived ES256 JWTs, and App Store Connect itself needs a paid Apple Developer Program membership. Community server: github.com/chrischall/app-store-connect-mcp, not official.

name: Attio
alternative: none
notes: Attio's hosted MCP signs in as the person's Attio user with OAuth and reads and writes CRM records, notes, tasks and call recordings. Discovery 2026-10-08: DCR yes, CIMD no, S256.

name: OpenAI Platform
alternative: The person's usage and billing exports from the OpenAI dashboard, or OpenAI models through Kipster's execution adapters
notes: The OpenAI API uses self-created API keys but is billed per use with no free tier; OpenAI's only MCP (developers.openai.com/mcp) searches developer docs and does not call the API. Community server: github.com/mcp-dir/openai_billing-mcp, not official.

name: MailerLite
alternative: none
notes: MailerLite's hosted MCP connects with OAuth authorization (no API key) on free and paid accounts, keeping campaigns as drafts until approved. Discovery 2026-10-08: DCR yes, CIMD no, S256.

name: Streak
alternative: none
notes: Streak's MCP uses OAuth and reaches boxes, contacts, organizations, timelines and pipelines (not email content); it needs a Streak Pro, Pro+ or Enterprise plan. Discovery 2026-10-08: DCR yes, CIMD no, S256.

name: ActiveCampaign
alternative: ActiveCampaign API v3 with the person's own API key
notes: ActiveCampaign's remote MCP has a per-account URL copied from Settings > Developer (template shown literally) and connects as a custom ChatGPT or Claude connector with plain OAuth and no client credentials, which suggests DCR; the account's discovery metadata could not be read without a real account subdomain, so DCR is not confirmed.

name: GoDaddy
alternative: GoDaddy REST API with the person's API key and secret for their own domains and DNS
notes: GoDaddy's documented MCP server needs no account or credential but only covers public domain search and availability (read-only); managing the person's own domains needs the separate REST API. Endpoint answers POST only (GET 405).

name: Deel
alternative: Personal access token as a bearer header
notes: Deel documents a remote MCP with OAuth and dynamic client registration, or a personal access token; the account needs API access enabled. Discovery 2026-10-08: DCR yes, CIMD no, S256.

name: Sendible
alternative: The person's report and post exports from Sendible (CSV), or the social networks' own APIs
notes: No official or community MCP found and no public developer documentation: the developer domain redirects to the marketing site and the pricing page lists no API. Registry 2026-10-08: no Sendible server.

name: Capsule CRM
alternative: Capsule REST API with a personal API token
notes: Capsule's remote MCP is OAuth only with a pre-registered client created self-serve in the Capsule Developer Hub (no DCR, no API tokens); it needs a Growth plan or above.

name: GetResponse
alternative: GetResponse API v3 with an API key
notes: GetResponse documents a remote MCP at the root URL with OAuth sign-in and no API key; GetResponse MAX accounts use a per-account template https://<your-account>.mcp.getresponse360.com. Discovery 2026-10-08: DCR yes, CIMD no, S256.

name: Nimble
alternative: Nimble REST API
notes: Nimble runs a beta remote MCP included in every Nimble plan, signed in with OAuth; the registry entry is in Nimble's namespace. Discovery 2026-10-08: DCR no, CIMD yes, S256.

name: AWeber
alternative: AWeber API with a registered developer app
notes: AWeber documents an official remote MCP (Streamable HTTP, OAuth 2.1). Discovery 2026-10-08: DCR yes, CIMD no, S256; no protected-resource metadata found.

name: npm
alternative: Public npm registry API without sign-in for package data
notes: No documented official npm MCP (mcp.npmjs.com answers but publishes no auth metadata or docs); the public registry API needs no key and a granular access token covers the person's packages. Community server: github.com/Nekzus/npm-sentinel-mcp, not official.

name: HeyGen
alternative: HeyGen API with an API key (separate API billing)
notes: HeyGen documents a remote MCP with OAuth that bills generations to the person's HeyGen plan credits. Discovery 2026-10-08: DCR yes, CIMD yes, S256.

name: Codeberg
alternative: Git over SSH or HTTPS for repository content
notes: Codeberg runs Forgejo with a public REST API and self-serve access tokens; no official MCP. Community server: github.com/mrfentmen/codeberg-mcp, not official.

name: Synthesia
alternative: Synthesia API with an API key
notes: Synthesia's remote MCP (public beta) needs a Starter or Pro plan or a WorkOS-login enterprise workspace. Discovery 2026-10-08: DCR yes, CIMD yes, S256.

name: Printful
alternative: Printful public OAuth app registered in the Developer Portal
notes: No official Printful MCP; the Printful API accepts a self-serve private token for the person's own store. Community server: github.com/m190/usefulapi-mcp (hosted third-party, flagged), not official.

name: MySQL
alternative: Community server for plain MySQL with the person's database credentials, e.g. github.com/neverinfamous/mysql-mcp (not official)
notes: Oracle's local MySQL MCP server (proof of concept) runs SQL with the person's own connection credentials but supports only MySQL AI and HeatWave modes, which are paid Oracle products; plain MySQL Community servers are covered only by many community servers in the registry.

name: Twilio
alternative: Twilio REST API with the person's account SID and API key
notes: Twilio's official local MCP (npm @twilio-alpha/mcp, Twilio Alpha) exposes the public Twilio APIs with a self-serve account SID, API key and secret; Twilio usage is pay as you go. The hosted mcp.twilio.com/docs server only searches API docs.

name: Brex
alternative: Brex API token from Settings > Developer as a bearer header
notes: Brex documents a remote MCP (beta, enabled per account) with OAuth and dynamic client registration or an admin-created API token; Brex is a business card and spend platform, so there is no personal account. Discovery 2026-10-08: DCR yes, CIMD no, S256.

name: Looker Studio
alternative: Read the report's underlying sources directly (Google Sheets, BigQuery) or the report's CSV export
notes: The Looker Studio API only searches and manages report assets, works only for Google Workspace or Cloud Identity organisations, and needs an admin to grant the app's client domain-wide delegation, so consumer Gmail accounts cannot use it. No Looker Studio MCP found (Google's Looker MCP tools target Looker, not Looker Studio).

name: Attentive
alternative: Attentive REST API through an OAuth app the person's company creates
notes: Attentive documents a remote MCP (beta, read-only unless ?readOnly=false) with OAuth sign-in; the beta must be enabled for the customer's company by its Attentive account team, and Attentive is sold to businesses. Discovery 2026-10-08: DCR yes, CIMD no, S256.

name: Mercury
alternative: Mercury REST API with an API token from the person's account
notes: Mercury runs a remote MCP (beta) with OAuth for reading transactions and balances, money movement held for approval in Mercury; personal accounts are a paid self-serve plan, and tools depend on account type. Discovery 2026-10-08: DCR yes, CIMD no, S256.

name: Drift
alternative: Publish a public Drift app with OAuth (Drift App Store submission)
notes: No official MCP found; the Drift API (now part of Salesloft) gives a non-expiring access token from a private app the person creates in their own Drift org, while OAuth for other orgs needs a published App Store app. Registry 2026-10-08: no Drift server.

name: Recurly
alternative: Recurly REST API v3 with a private API key from the site
notes: Recurly hosts a remote MCP on its own domain with OAuth on oauth.recurly.com, but no vendor documentation page for it was found, so scope and plan limits are unconfirmed; Recurly is a merchant billing platform with self-serve signup. Discovery 2026-10-08: DCR yes, CIMD yes, S256.

name: Shippo
alternative: Shippo REST API with the person's API token
notes: Shippo's hosted MCP signs in to the person's live Shippo account with OAuth (no API key); rates, address checks and tracking are free, label purchases charge the account. Discovery 2026-10-08: DCR yes, CIMD no, S256.

name: Lattice
alternative: Lattice remote MCP if Lattice grants a pre-registered OAuth client
notes: Lattice runs a remote MCP whose OAuth server offers no DCR or CIMD and has no public client registration docs, so the usable route is the Lattice REST API with an API key created in the admin dashboard. Discovery 2026-10-08: DCR no, CIMD no, S256.

name: Kustomer
alternative: none
notes: No official MCP found; the Kustomer REST API uses bearer API keys that an admin creates self-serve in Settings > Security > API Keys with chosen roles. Registry 2026-10-08: no Kustomer server.

name: Novo
alternative: Novo transactions synced to the person's accounting app (QuickBooks, Xero) or a statement/CSV export
notes: Novo is small-business banking with built-in integrations (QuickBooks, Xero, Stripe, Zapier) but no public developer API was found. Registry 2026-10-08: no Novo server.

name: Render
alternative: Render REST API with the same API key
notes: Render documents a hosted MCP that takes a self-serve API key from Account Settings as a bearer header; its OAuth sign-in is for Render's own client plugins (no DCR or CIMD advertised). Discovery 2026-10-08: DCR no, CIMD no, S256.

name: Ideogram
alternative: Ideogram REST API with an API key
notes: Ideogram documents a remote MCP signed in with OAuth through the person's Ideogram account; usage draws on the same plan credits as the web app. Its developer docs MCP only searches documentation. Discovery 2026-10-08: DCR yes, CIMD no, S256.

name: Glide
alternative: none
notes: Glide documents a remote MCP for GlideOS organizations on Pro and Enterprise plans, signed in with OAuth; the endpoint is from Glide's registry entry (dev.glideapps/mcp) since the docs show it only in-app. Discovery 2026-10-08: DCR yes, CIMD yes, S256.

name: Pika
alternative: none
notes: Pika's MCP page gives an experimental remote MCP with OAuth sign-in through Pika's Supabase auth server, plus a companion skill; generations draw on the person's Pika credits. Discovery 2026-10-08: DCR yes, CIMD no, S256.

name: Moz
alternative: Moz API token as the x-moz-token header
notes: Moz documents remote MCP servers for Moz Data (and https://api.moz.com/mcp/v1/local for Moz Local) with OAuth or an API token; the API has a free tier of 50 rows a month (card required), paid tiers above. Discovery 2026-10-08: DCR yes, CIMD no, S256.

name: Deputy
alternative: none
notes: No official Deputy MCP; the project creates a Deputy OAuth client self-serve in Deputy Once (from a free trial install) with no review, and sign-in reaches the person's regional install. Community server: github.com/hyperdrift-io/deputy-workforce-mcp, not official.

name: Trustpilot
alternative: Trustpilot review notification emails in the person's mailbox, or the Integration Partner programme for a shared app
notes: No official Trustpilot MCP; the Business API (OAuth for private data) needs the paid API module, with tiered yearly call allowances (Enterprise includes tier 1). Community server: github.com/saulius876-lgtm/trustpilot-reviews (registry), not official.

name: When I Work
alternative: Shift and schedule notification emails in the person's mailbox
notes: No official When I Work MCP found (mcp.wheniwork.com only redirects to the app login); API keys are not self-serve: an account admin must email When I Work, who check the plan is eligible (an upgrade may be needed). Community server: io.usefulapi/when-i-work (hosted by usefulapi.io, routes data through a third party), not official.

name: Hunter
alternative: Hunter API key in the X-API-Key header
notes: Hunter runs a remote MCP on all plans including the free account, with one-click OAuth or the person's API key. Discovery 2026-10-08: DCR yes, CIMD no, S256.

name: LaunchDarkly
alternative: LaunchDarkly local MCP server with an API access token
notes: LaunchDarkly documents a hosted MCP for feature flags, AgentControl and observability (not in its federal or EU instances, which use the local server); a free Developer plan exists. Discovery 2026-10-08: DCR yes, CIMD no, S256.

name: Typefully
alternative: Typefully API key as a bearer header for headless clients
notes: Typefully documents one remote MCP URL for everyone with OAuth sign-in and no API key; no plan requirement is stated. Discovery 2026-10-08: DCR yes, CIMD yes, S256.

name: Invoice Ninja
alternative: Self-hosted Invoice Ninja, where the API is free
notes: No official Invoice Ninja MCP; the REST API takes a token the person creates (X-API-TOKEN), and hosted accounts get REST API access from the Pro plan up (not the free plan). Community server: github.com/ambaloo/invoiceninja-mcp, not official.

name: BrowserStack
alternative: BrowserStack local MCP server (github.com/browserstack/mcp-server) with the person's username and access key
notes: BrowserStack documents a remote MCP that uses OAuth, alongside its local server; testing runs on the person's BrowserStack trial or paid plan. Discovery 2026-10-08: DCR yes, CIMD no, S256.
